_about: One entry per Play Keralam game: names, colours, page, how it plays and the post formats it rotates through. Facts come from the site's README; keep them true to the games. Daily-game puzzles in posts are always YESTERDAY's (see PLAYBOOK.md).

vaakku.pitch_en: A Malayalam Wordle. Guess the day's word in six tries.
vaakku.pitch_ml: മലയാളം വേർഡിൽ. ഇന്നത്തെ വാക്ക് ആറ് ശ്രമത്തിൽ കണ്ടുപിടിക്കൂ.
facts: The word has 3 or 4 boxes; each box holds one akshara, so a conjunct like ക്ക or a chillu like ൻ fits in one box.
Green: right letter, right box. Yellow: in the word, another box. Grey: nothing from that letter's family.
Type on the on-screen aksharamaala, or in English letters: 'kappal' becomes കപ്പൽ.
A new word every day at midnight India time, the same for everyone.
Streak awards: Chiraath (ചിരാത്) at 3 days, Nilavilakku (നിലവിളക്ക്) at 10, Chundan vallam (ചുണ്ടൻ വള്ളം) at 50, Gajarajan (ഗജരാജൻ) at 100.
Guesses are checked against about 326,000 Malayalam words.

paryayam.pitch_en: One Malayalam word a day. Find its five best-known synonyms.
paryayam.pitch_ml: ദിവസവും ഒരു വാക്ക്. അതിന്റെ അഞ്ച് പര്യായങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തൂ.
facts: Type in English letters (Manglish): aadithyan, adityan and adhithyan all make ആദിത്യൻ.
Five tiles fill in as you find the five; any other synonym counts as a bonus word.
Hint shows one more letter of a word each tap; Give up shows all five.
A new word every day at midnight India time.

thaaranira.pitch_en: Name the Malayalam film from its cast, one name at a time.
thaaranira.pitch_ml: താരനിര കണ്ട് മലയാള സിനിമയുടെ പേര് പറയൂ.
facts: You see the first name in IMDb's top cast; every wrong guess shows the next one, up to ten.
Spelling needn't be exact: 'kiridam' finds Kireedam.
792 well-known films, a new one every day at midnight India time, no repeat for over two years.

katha.pitch_en: Read a Malayalam film's story and name the film. Ten stories a day, easy to hard.
katha.pitch_ml: കഥ വായിച്ച് സിനിമ ഏതെന്ന് പറയൂ. ദിവസവും പത്ത് കഥകൾ.
facts: The story is IMDb's description with the film's own name blacked out.
Three tries per story: the first miss shows the year and genre, the second the director and top star.
Rounds 1-3 are easy, 4-7 medium, 8-10 hard.

aadyam.pitch_en: Two Malayalam films: tap the one that came out first.
facts: An endless run: it ends on the first wrong answer; your score is how many in a row.
It gets harder: the gap starts at 15+ years and shrinks to under a month.
1,905 films, each card with its director and first three stars.

ashwamedham.pitch_en: Think of any Malayalam film. It asks yes/no questions until it names it.
ashwamedham.pitch_ml: ഒരു മലയാള സിനിമ മനസ്സിൽ വിചാരിക്കൂ. ചോദ്യങ്ങൾ ചോദിച്ച് അത് കണ്ടുപിടിക്കും.
facts: After the Malayalam TV quiz Ashwamedham.
It knows 6,656 Malayalam films, even ones with no ratings.
Answer yes, no or not sure; Undo takes back an answer.
It names the film once it is 80% sure, and gives up after three wrong names or 30 questions.

antakshari.pitch_en: Stuck on a letter in film Antakshari? Get films that start with it.
antakshari.pitch_ml: സിനിമ അന്താക്ഷരിയിൽ ഒരു അക്ഷരത്തിൽ കുടുങ്ങിയോ? സഹായം ഇവിടെ.
facts: Pick a letter and see every film that starts with it, best known first.
Type the film the other side said; it jumps to its last letter.
Covers 6,176 released Malayalam films.

kerala-guesser.pitch_en: GeoGuessr for Kerala: find places on a blank map.
facts: Three levels: the 14 districts, the 140 assembly constituencies, or all 1,034 local bodies.
Ten places a game, out of 1,000 points; anywhere inside the place scores 100.
After each guess the map shows how far off you were.

thurupp.pitch_en: Kerala's card game 28, online with friends or against bots.
facts: Four players in two teams, partners sitting opposite; 28 points in the deck; one hidden trump.
Make a room and share its code; empty seats are filled by bots.
Or play offline against three bots.

cidmoosa.pitch_en: A 3D car chase from Thiruvananthapuram to Kasaragod in Moosa's gadget car.
cidmoosa.pitch_ml: തിരുവനന്തപുരം മുതൽ കാസർഗോഡ് വരെ ഒരു 3D കാർ ചേസ്.
facts: Police jeeps and Bullet bikes chase Moosa's red convertible.
Gadgets: Goli (marbles), oil slick, smoke screen and chilli powder.
Thorappan can throw eggs and steel plates from the back seat.
Each district you reach opens as a new start; Easy, Medium or Hard.
On a phone, the screen is the controller.

sat.pitch_en: Kerala hide-and-seek in 3D. Race to the wall and shout SAT!
facts: One player counts at the wall while everyone hides; when you're spotted, race to the wall and shout SAT!
Set in a two-storey tharavad with a nadumuttam, coconut palms, a mango-tree swing, a well and a haystack.
Up to 10 players, bots fill empty slots, and online rooms to play with friends.

general.all-games: All 11 games at a glance, daily and any-time.
general.daily-four: The four daily games (Vaakku, Paryayam, Thaaranira, Katha): new at midnight India time, the same for everyone; each keeps its own streak; the front page lights one lamp per game once it is done, with confetti when all four are. (The named streak awards belong to Vaakku only.)
general.front-page: The front page is a Pooram at night: lights, fireworks, two elephants, and today's date in both the English and the Malayalam calendar (Kollavarsham).
general.streaks: Streaks: every daily game keeps a streak. Vaakku's streak awards are Chiraath (3 days), Nilavilakku (10), Chundan vallam (50) and Gajarajan (100); say they are Vaakku's. The front page lights a lamp per daily game done today, confetti when all four are.
general.weekend-challenge: A weekend challenge: finish all four daily games today and comment your scores.

_shots: 'shot' is the local path shoot.py opens for a phone screenshot (null: a 3D game that needs a build; use designed slides instead). The front page is '/'.
